articles.title: GTA 6 for Xbox: You Can Save $10, Today Only
articles.summary: Here’s a good deal for any Xbox Series X|S owner who hasn’t preordered Grand Theft Auto 6 yet. Today only, by taking advantage of an Xbox gift card deal at Newegg, you can effectively knock $10 off the price of GTA 6. How does it work, you ask?
body: How does it work, you ask? Newegg is offering $5 off $50 Xbox gift cards if you enter promo code LDSF373 at checkout. Thankfully, the code stacks, so you can add two gift cards to your cart to get $10 off $100 worth of credit.

As luck would have it, the ultimate edition of GTA 6, the one most people are buying, is available to preorder on Xbox for $99.99. Put it all together, and you effectively save $10 off GTA 6. But remember, the deal is good today only.

Why preorder GTA 6 at all? It can be safely assumed that the game will carry a massive file size. If you preorder, you can preload it starting November 12, a week ahead of launch. That way it’ll be installed on your system and ready to play the moment it comes out.

We had only gotten a sprinkling of specifics about GTA 6 over the past few years until last week’s extended look blew the game open with 27 minutes of frankly awesome-looking gameplay footage. I was expecting it to look incredible, but it actually exceeded my expectations. Games like this don’t come around often.

articles.title: New Resident Evil Teaser Trailer Reveals First Glimpse at Creature That Looks a Lot Like Las Plagas
articles.summary: A new Spanish-language teaser trailer for Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil movie includes never-before-seen footage of a tentacle-like mutation that looks frighteningly similar to Las Plagas from Resident Evil 4.
body: The teaser, published on September 4, 2026, sees Bryan Hodukavich (played by Austin Abrams) cautiously walk into the maternity ward of a hospital, which seems to have been overtaken by some kind of fleshy substance — and, tragically, so have all the bassinets meant to hold newborn babies.

Another shot from the trailer shows a corpse’s feet being consumed by thin, wormlike vines. That corpse raises itself up a second later, seemingly animated by one of these vines protruding from its cheek as a horrified Hodukavich looks on.

Needless to say, this has already sparked comparisons to Las Plagas, the parasite responsible for the Los Illuminados Incident in RE4. That particular mutation notably boasted tentacle-like growths, which would transform into terrifying beings as their growth stages progressed.

Cregger has been open about his inspiration for his Resident Evil movie, saying that RE4 and RE7 had the biggest influence on his creative approach to the film. "I like the idea of borrowing the rhythm and scale from [Resident Evil] 4 and using some of the character elements from [Resident Evil] 7," he said in a September 1 Reddit AMA.

articles.title: All match overrides and console locations in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4
articles.summary: Match overrides change the way you play Fortnite in Chapter 7 Season 4. Here are all the match overrides and where to find override consoles.
body: Match overrides allow you to change how Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 is played, but only if you interact with the override console first.

Luckily, override consoles will spawn in the same locations every game and they can be activated every game. However, only one override console will be activatable at a time, and it'll be activatable at a random time during the match. More override consoles can activate later on in a game, but the number will vary.

If you're the first person to interact with a console, you can choose between three match overrides, each of which will adjust the rules in your Fortnite game. These overrides can increase your sprint speed, give you more XP, make your pickaxes deal more damage, and much more. Some match overrides might also only affect your squad, rather than the entire lobby.
Below we've listed where you can find every override console in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 and all the match overrides.

articles.title: DLSS 5 Will Be Coming to Older Graphics Cards After All
articles.summary: Nvidia's DLSS 5 neural rendering tech officially debuted yesterday in NBA 2K27, and it's only supported on current-generation RTX 5000 graphics cards. But it seems like that'll change over time.
body: On Nvidia's forums, an employee claimed that the company will be expanding DLSS 5 support to RTX 40 series graphics cards at some point, but we're probably going to wait a while for it. He said, "Our current focus is on optimizing performance for the GeForce RTX 50 Series with model updates expected later this fall," but noted that "once RTX 50 Series performance is more fully tuned, we plan to work on expanding official support to the GeForce RTX 40 Series."

So, it seems like the company's focus, at least for now, is to get it running smoother on current-generation graphics cards before retrofitting it to its Ada Lovelace architecture. That makes a lot of sense, too. I've briefly messed around with the technology in NBA 2K27, and I was surprised by how subtle the changes were, at least compared to some of the nightmare fuel I've seen on Reddit. But even though the technology did make NBA 2K27 look better, it had a massive impact to performance, and I was testing it on an RTX 5090.

articles.title: Game Director Finally Addresses His Rumored Foot Fetish–Wait, Not Kojima, The Other One
articles.summary: A prolific Japanese game developer has finally addressed all that weird foot imagery in his video games. What? No, I'm not talking about Hideo Kojima (he's busy hanging out with The Backrooms director right now, anyway).
body: “It's not necessarily something I’m consistently aware of--maybe it’s something subconscious coming through,” Miyazaki told The Guardian in response to a question about all the hand imagery in his upcoming action-RPG, The Duskbloods. "Take a look online and there’s a rumor that I have a bit of a thing for feet, but I’m not honestly sure where this comes from."

Though Miyazaki says he's not sure where the idea that he has a "thing for feet" comes from, it's something fans of his games have noticed for years. Whether we're talking The Maiden in Black from Demons' Souls or Priscilla (or Gwunevere, or Sister Friede, or Maneater Mildred) from Dark Souls, it's hard to ignore how many barefoot women are roaming Miyazaki's fictional worlds. Elden Ring's Malenia is rocking bare feet, too, although hers are metal prosthetics. The game's beaches even differentiate between barefoot players and those who are wearing footwear.
So what's with all the shoeless women in Souls games? According to Miyazaki, it's about depicting the human experience. Or something.
"I feel like I’m trying to depict some side of human nature or the human existence that is difficult to describe,” he elaborated.

articles.title: Nearly a decade on, legendary director Hideki Kamiya says he's "100% serious" about reviving Xbox's canned Scalebound
articles.summary: Hideki Kamiya was being super serious about resurrecting Scalebound, the PlatinumGames dragon-filled romp that was cancelled by Xbox nearly a decade ago.
body: The famed director has been at the helm of almost too many beloved games - Bayonetta, Resident Evil 2, Devil May Cry, Okami - so it's pretty easy to look back and wonder what could've been with his canned Xbox project. But it seems that thought pops up in Kamiya's head now and then, too.

When asked if he's spoken to Xbox CEO Asha Sharma about reviving the game, in an interview with VGC, Kamiya said no, but he's more than willing to rekindle the professional relationship. "Now's my opportunity to once again say that if they want to do it, let's make it happen!" He also mentioned that a number of PlatinumGames alumni now work at his new development studio Clovers, which is currently making Okami 2, another long-awaited comeback.

"Of course, it's very unfortunate that the project was unable to see the light of day ultimately, and that is something that even now I still very strongly desire to be able to see through if it's all possible, and I'm being 100% serious when I say that," Kamiya continued.

articles.title: Two Nintendo Directs Announced For Next Week, Including A Zelda Presentation
articles.summary: Not one, but two Nintendo Directs are coming next week. Nintendo has confirmed that a Legend of Zelda Direct will be held on September 8 at 7 AM PT / 10 AM ET, and it'll be followed by a Nintendo Direct on September 9 at the same times.
body: Rumors of a Nintendo Direct began picking up earlier this week after Ubisoft announced that a new look at Just Dance: Decades of Hits was on the way. It's worth noting that the publisher announced it for September 10, but given how often Just Dance games appear in Nintendo broadcasts, it was assumed this would be the date of a Nintendo Direct. With Nintendo hosting a September Nintendo Direct almost every year for the past decade--with 2024 being an exception--it looked like it was only a matter of time before the broadcast was officially announced.

As for what you can expect, Nintendo is keeping its lips zipped for now. Last year's September Direct was focused on several first-party games, smaller third-party titles, and the surprise reveal of a new Virtual Boy headset designed for Switch consoles, so we're guessing that it'll be more of the same for 2026. Following the release of the Switch 2 in 2025 and a steady stream of first-party games, 2026 has been slower by comparison, so here's hoping we get to see what new experiences Nintendo is working on. Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is out later this month, so we'll probably get a new trailer for the turn-based tactics game.

articles.title: Resident Evil 2 Director Thinks There’s a Chance His Canceled Xbox-Exclusive Will Still Happen
articles.summary: If there's anybody in the game industry who knows good things come to those who wait, it's Hideki Kamiya. The director of games like Resident Evil 2 and co-founder of PlatinumGames had to wait nearly two decades to announce an Okami sequel.
body: Scalebound was first revealed during Microsoft's 2014 E3 press conference as a new Xbox-exclusive title from PlatinumGames, directed by Kamiya. In the years following the announcement, details about the massive action game that let you control a soldier with a dragon companion were intermittently revealed. After being delayed once, Microsoft eventually canceled Scalebound entirely in 2017. Following the cancellation, Kamiya wrote in an X post, "I'll work hard to never have to let you down like this again."

Even almost a decade after its cancellation, however, Kamiya still has hope. When asked by Video Games Chronicle if he had reached out to new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma about Scalebound, he responded, "Well, no, but now's my opportunity to once again say that if they want to do it, let's make it happen!" Kamiya added that Clovers CEO and former PlatinumGames coworker Kento Koyama is also on board to return.

articles.title: Miami Wants To Turn The City Into 'GTA 6' And Cops Aren't Happy About It
articles.summary: Though Grand Theft Auto 6 takes place in a fictional American state called Leonida, Rockstar's massive map recreates some areas of Florida. For Florida's tourism sector, then, the immediate popularity of GTA 6 is a dream come true.
body: Rockstar has not yet signed off on the proposal, nor is there any indication that the idea will move forward. A few days after the pitch deck was shared with the public, however, Miami-Dade's Sheriff's Office decried the idea. The Miami Herald reported that Sheriff Rosie Cordero-Stutz openly disapproved of the idea of working with a video game that promotes criminal activity.

“Its fictional world includes murder, robbery, drug trafficking, carjacking, violence against law enforcement, and other conduct that the men and women of the Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office work every single day to prevent," Cordero-Stutz told the publication. Similar sentiments were expressed by other local officials in Miami-Dade, but at least some of them acknowledged the potential economic benefits the plan could bring.

articles.title: Steam Has Generated $15 Billion In Revenue So Far In 2026, And New Games Are A Big Part Of It
articles.summary: As the platform that gets the lion's share of PC game sales, Steam naturally makes a lot of money every year from commissions, publishing fees, and more through its storefront. But how much cash has it made so far in 2026?
body: Steam's top releases by gross revenue include AAA games and breakout indie hits, with Forza Horizon 6 leading the charge. The new racing game earned Steam $210.5 million in revenue, while Crimson Desert sales were responsible for $203.3 million, Resident Evil Requiem made just over $200.9 million, and Slay the Spire 2 brought in over $148 million. Rounding out the list is Subnautica 2 at $139.2 million and Meccha Chameleon at $89.8 million.

Looking ahead, Steam's coffers can expect an influx of cash from highly anticipated releases like Phantom Blade Zero, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and Gears of War: E-Day, just to name a few. Valve gets a cut from whatever is sold on Steam, including the lucrative microtransactions and DLC that accompany most games these days. Elliot also spoke to GameSpot recently about what goes into a game price tag as part of our Cheap Week deep-dives.

articles.summary: In a TV landscape where series often take multiple years between seasons ( Severance, *cough, cough*), Silo fans are in for some great news. After the show’s third season wrapped last night, Apple TV has already released the first trailer for season four, revealing the show will return in under a…
body: The teaser recaps the massive twists dropped in the last few episodes, then quickly shifts to new footage as Paul Billings shares a secret with the people of the Silo. We see many of the characters from the pre-Silo world looking on in shock. The trailer shows other Silos, scenes of rebellion, and Juliette Nichols battling drones. “What’s your name? Who are you?” our heroine asks Senator Thurman. “I don’t know,” he replies. The trailer concludes, revealing that the show’s fourth and final season will premiere on July 9, 2027.

As for how Silo is coming back so quickly, seasons three and four were filmed back-to-back. Season three began filming in October 2024 and wrapped in May 2025, while season four began filming in August 2025 and finished in March 2026. Post-production will likely take several months.

Silo is a sci-fi series set in a giant underground bunker, following a subterranean society of 10,000 people governed by arcane rules laid out generations ago. The show stars Rebecca Ferguson as Juliette Nichols, an engineer who ends up pursuing the secrets of this place.

articles.title: Hype for GTA 6 is giving PS5 and Xbox console sales a much needed 30% boost
articles.summary: GTA 6 is already giving PlayStation and Xbox consoles a much needed sales boost, at least in the UK, even though Rockstar Games ' inevitable pile of cash doesn't drop for another couple of months.
body: GTA 6: An Extended Look was a pretty big deal by itself. Almost 4m people tuned in on livestreaming platforms to get their first look at Lucia and Jason doing crime and maybe falling in/out of love, overwhelming Twitch in the process. Over 31m folks watched the deep dive directly on Netflix, along with a further 22m people who checked it out on YouTube (not accounting for re-uploads).

As reported on by The Game Business, all that excitement fuelled a pretty big sales week for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles. In the UK, sales of the PS5 shot up by 33%, while Xbox Series sales saw a 34% boost, according to market research firm NielsonIQ.

The console makers are likely letting out loud sighs of relief - with a few more held back for GTA 6's November release date, of course. Spiralling costs and an ongoing component crisis has made selling consoles a little tough lately. PS5 UK console sales dropped dramatically this summer and Xbox's 2025 was its worst year on record in the country.
points: GTA 6 is already giving PlayStation and Xbox consoles a much needed sales boost, at least in the UK, even though Rockstar Games ' inevitable pile of cash doesn't drop for another couple of months.

articles.title: Next week, for the first time ever, Nintendo is hosting two Directs back-to-back - and the first one is dedicated to The Legend of Zelda's 40th anniversary
articles.summary: Back in June, we learned that we're officially getting a The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, which is supposedly coming to Switch 2 later this year (and we first heard rumours about it back in Marc h).
body: Enter next week's Nintendo Direct. Nintendo has announced it will livestream a special, dedicated The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct next week, wihch will be followed by a second, more general Nintendo Direct.

The Zelda presentation will take place on September 8 at 7am PT / 10am ET / 3pm BST and last about 30 minutes. As its name suggests, the Zelda Direct will share information about how Nintendo plans to commemorate the Zelda series’ 40th anniversary. Will we finally see a trailer for the Legend of Zelda movie?

The Zelda presentation takes place on 8th September at 3pm BST, 7am PT, and 10am ET. It's set to last about 30 minutes. We will certainly get more news on Ocarina here, but I'd also expect to see some other tidbits from Zelda as Nintendo pulls back the curtain on what to expect for the big anniversary celebration.

The next day, 9th September, a general Nintendo Direct will take place on at 3pm BST, 7am PT and 10am ET. This one is going to take 45 minutes, and will be specifically aimed at Nintendo Switch 2 games coming this winter. There'll be a Nintendo Treehouse: Live session afterwards that last nearly two hours (110 minutes).
